summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed discrepancies in location data for several Pakistani cities (Hyderabad, Sukkur, Islamabad). Specific issues noted included zero female demographics in Hyderabad and missing demographic data entirely for Islamabad. It was confirmed that the raw data provided appears to be from November 2025 and does not include full demographic information.

It was highlighted that payment was made for both 1200 locations' data and specific demographic data, suggesting a discrepancy with the received dataset.
decisions: The team will first request city-level data regarding the missing demographics.
action_items: Follow up on obtaining complete demographic data for all 1200 paid locations.
